scheme_name: Financial Assistive Devices for Persons with Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana.
Disability of at least 40% is required.
Age must be above 18 years, except for persons with mental retardation where the minimum age is 14 years.
Applicant must be employed in a reputable organization or have a confirmed appointment letter.
For self‑employment, the need for an assistive device will be assessed by the authority (SCA/RRB, etc.).
The head of the organization must certify that the proposed assistive device will improve employability and that the device is not provided by the organization.
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹5 lakh are provided for purchase of assistive devices to enhance employability or self‑employment prospects.
